exact_final_generation_prompt:
Create one sophisticated luxury-fashion visualization of a Ready-to-Wear. Identity contract: Extreme-bias fabric panels create a skirt whose textile structure stretches and rotates around the legs in motion. A continuous spiral assembly anchored at a stable waistband converts walking motion into changing tension and silhouette. The product remains a wearable skirt with a secure waist and usable leg movement. Bias orientation, spiral continuity, and waistband anchoring must remain functional construction rather than printed spiral graphics. Approved redesign: Use a graduated spiral with broader quiet upper panels and increasingly expressive lower rotation. Resolve a long lean column at rest that opens into controlled asymmetric volume during stride. Use luminous off-white silk as the field, a restrained Butter Yellow kinetic edge, and a quiet leather anchor band. Express strong proportions, material credibility, controlled novelty, intentional color, visual hierarchy, restraint, and plausible premium execution. The structural mechanism must remain operative and recognizable, never a decorative imitation. Do not change category, merge concepts, substitute a conventional product, or claim validated manufacturability or commercial readiness. One coherent product; no logos or text.
Variation 1 — architectural_clarity: Make the evaluated mechanism immediately legible through a disciplined, architectural silhouette and controlled luxury proportions.
Render one coherent product only, with no logos, captions, or text.
